newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: SOCIETE GENERALE EMRG EYE PORTFOLIO INVESTMENT.
newsitem.headline: SOCIETE GENERALE EMRG EYE PORTFOLIO INVESTMENT.

text.p: French Societe Generale European Emerging Markets Ltd said on Monday night that it was interested in particpating in the country's privatisation process as well as in secondary market transactions.

"We investigate the investment opportunities via primary offers and secondly to develop as the major local player in the secondary market," Tim Harris, head of research at Societe Generale European Emerging Markets, told a news conference.
He said that the company was attracted by the advanced stage of privatisation, the atractive and benign investment climate and improving macroeconomic situtaion in the country.

"We believe that the Lithuanian market has now reached the stage when West European and American fund managers will be able to get direct portfolio investments...the opportunities did not exist until today" Harris added.
"We recognise that the telecom market is very attractive," Harris said. "The banking sector offers attractive opportunities. Ship building and port companies would be excellent opportunities."
He mentioned other "basic industries" like textiles as areas of interest.
Harris also said that they planned to visit Lithuanian Telecom, Mazeikiu Nafta, Birzhu Milk, Medienos Plaushas, Vilniaus Bank and Hermis Bank in the next few days.
"We plan to spend much time in the next 12 months here," Harris said.
"We have dedicated analysts based in London to research the markets of Lithuania, Latvia and Estonia and we are keen to identify opportunities in both primary and secondary markets," Harris said.
